data.desc: ArcBest (Nasdaq: ARCB) is a multibillion-dollar integrated logistics company delivering end-to-end supply chain solutions designed around how businesses operate. Partnering with 30,000+ customers across the globe, ArcBest combines the reliability and control of an asset-based LTL network, the reach and flexibility of a brokerage network, and innovative technology to help build stronger, more efficient supply chains. ArcBest View , the company's digital logistics platform, gives customers greater control and clarity by bringing quoting, booking, shipment visibility and reporting into one connected experience. With 14,000 employees, 230 campuses and service centers, and over a century of expertise, ArcBest delivers a premium experience built on reliable service, clear visibility and responsive support.
